texts: mixed: the Northcove lanterns, the burning and the reason-ask all come through, but "through winter" flattens to a bare winter time-stamp, so the question ends up asking why the lanterns burn at some point in winter rather than why they burn the whole season — and it will miss a stored fact that records the burning as lasting across winter. Rewrite as "Why do the Northcove lanterns burn throughout the winter?": our translator has a proper whole-extent relation for "throughout" (and "during"/"while") but none for "through", so that one word swap keeps the season-long force without changing what you are asking.
